entities.name: Ferdinand Thomas Unger

entities.summary: Ferdinand Thomas Unger was a United States Army Lieutenant General, High Commissioner of the United States Civil Administration of the Ryukyu Islands, and governor of the U.S. Soldiers' and Airmen's Home in Northwest Washington D.C.
